title: Made-in China, Thinking in America: U.S. Values Persist in Chinese LLMs
reasoning: The paper investigates the moral and ethical values of LLMs using the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-2) and the World Values Survey (WVS). It specifically evaluates ethical dimensions such as Care, Equality, Loyalty, Authority, and Purity to determine how models align with human moral frameworks.
